dataset.description: AACR-Bench reflection test set: comment-level binary ground truth (label 1 = correct, 0 = incorrect) over real PR review comments.

framework.role: M1 judging delegation (judge.py / evaluate.py); M0 needs no judge (labels are supplied).

fixtures.description: M1 end-to-end fixture: one task per positive_samples PR. Every reference comment is label=1 by construction (the upstream positive split), so this fixture measures precision/recall against known-correct review comments, not verifier kill-rate.
fixtures.citation: arXiv 2601.19494 (see the top-level citation.bibtex; every generated fixture header repeats it)
fixtures.output: tests/eval/aacr/fixtures/test-set.json (derived upstream data, gitignored; rebuild with fixtures/build-fixture.js)

ocr.role: M0 comparison arm (--arm ocr), ported with attribution into src/agents/ocr-reflection-prompt.ts.

citation.notice: Data and framework are Apache-2.0. Use of AACR-Bench requires citing arXiv 2601.19494; every generated results file and JSONL header carries this notice.

materialization.diffBase: merge-base reported by the GitHub compare API for (pr_source_commit ... pr_target_commit), fetched with --depth 1
materialization.head: pr_target_commit (capture-time PR head; the file content the comment was anchored to)
materialization.perCommentDiff: git diff -U3 <diffBase> <head> -- <path> from a depth-1 fetch of both commits
materialization.failurePolicy: every failure becomes an error row; a materialization run never aborts
